stage: Evidence-Triggered Baseline Hold — Reopen Trigger Monitoring
purpose: Record a targeted current-public-evidence monitoring pass after scientific-baseline integration. This pass tests only declared reopen conditions and may not create a new model specification, infer missing evidence, inspect reserved outcomes, or reopen calibration merely because time has elapsed.

monitoring_scope.principle: Search for genuinely new public evidence or external events that match already-declared reopen triggers. Non-confirmation is not proof of permanent source absence.
screened_classes: direct Romania industrial import transaction-price index trigger

evidence.fact: BNR kept the policy rate at 6.50% on 2026-08-10.
The next BNR monetary-policy meeting was announced for 2026-10-08.

prospective_monetary_policy_event.trigger_test: The prospective contract requires a non-zero BNR policy-rate event before Stage 1 may open.
prospective_monetary_policy_event.conclusion: No non-zero event has occurred in the reserved prospective window as of this monitoring date; reserved MIR response values remain closed.

evidence.fact: An exact official Q1-2025 BLS workbook is indexed, confirming the workbook publication family.
A later Q2 survey publication is indexed, but it does not establish the missing exact 2025-Q2 workbook endpoint.

aggregate_bank_credit_bls_2025_q2.search_result: Targeted official-domain searches did not identify an exact official 2025-Q2 workbook endpoint or machine-readable catalogue target.
aggregate_bank_credit_bls_2025_q2.boundary_rule: Do not guess BNR filenames, timestamps or internal endpoints and do not substitute rounded publication text for exact workbook cells.
aggregate_bank_credit_bls_2025_q2.conclusion: The declared source-materialisation trigger is not satisfied.

evidence.fact: The dataset is the correct conceptual family: monthly transaction-price development of imported industrial goods.
The PEEI table reports '-' for Romania under industrial import prices for the reference period covered by that report; the report also notes this indicator is mandatory only for euro-area countries.

evidence.source: Eurostat Statistics Explained industrial import price overview
evidence.fact: Non-euro-area EU countries may provide the series voluntarily, so historical non-availability cannot be treated as proof of permanent absence.

fx_inflation_direct_import_price.conclusion: A current exact Romania series has not been confirmed. The existence and freshness of sts_inpi_m alone do not satisfy the RMD reopen trigger.

evidence.fact: BIS publishes total private-sector DSRs for 32 economies and household/NFC breakdowns for 17 economies.
The DSR dataset received a 2026-Q1 release on 2026-09-14.

household_debt_service_burden.search_result: The fresh release did not yield a confirmed Romania household DSR series in the indexed public surface used in this pass.
household_debt_service_burden.boundary_rule: Debt stock or debt-to-income ratios are not substitutes for an observed aggregate debt-service burden aligned to the S1M consumption population.
household_debt_service_burden.conclusion: Household-consumption and credit-risk reopen triggers remain unsatisfied.

evidence.source: Romania Ministry of Finance Government Debt Management Strategy 2024-2026
evidence.fact: The strategy reports portfolio refinancing and interest-rate risk indicators, including debt due/refixing within one year and average time to maturity/refixing.

government_refinancing_effective_rate.boundary_rule: The frozen mechanism requires same-boundary opening principal, realised repriced/refinanced principal, and matched old/new effective rates across material debt blocks.
government_refinancing_effective_rate.conclusion: The surfaced portfolio risk indicators do not supply the matched repricing ledger required for point identification.

accounting_and_sectoral_financial_positi.conclusion: This targeted pass identified no new official source that satisfies the frozen bilateral/counterparty requirements for incomplete F2/F4/F5/F6/F7/F8 or the full quarterly non-consolidated sector-by-counterpart stock+transaction reference-mode boundary.
accounting_and_sectoral_financial_positi.caveat: This is a monitoring result, not a proof that no provider-side or future source can exist. Reopen remains evidence-triggered.

next_monitoring_conditions: A non-zero BNR policy-rate decision followed by the contract-required official MIR response release.
An exact official BNR 2025-Q2 BLS workbook or exact machine-readable equivalent.
A current exact Romania sts_inpi_m transaction-price series or another genuinely new preregisterable FX identification source.
A matched Romania household debt-service burden / population bridge.
A genuinely new accounting/reference-mode counterpart source satisfying the frozen sector, instrument, frequency and transaction boundaries.
